item.title: Gracie Abrams Announces ‘Daughter From Hell’ Bonus Tracks Available ‘For a Limited Time’
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host speaks]
Host: "Hey music fans, welcome back to our podcast! We've got some exciting news for you tonight. Gracie Abrams is dropping not one, but two brand new bonus tracks from her latest album, Daughter From Hell. Yes, you heard that right - just a few days after the album's release, Abrams is treating her fans to even more music."
[Short music clip from Gracie Abrams plays]
Host: "The two tracks, 'Out of Nowhere' and 'Love Letter', didn't make it to the standard album release, but they're now available exclusively on iTunes for a limited time. Abrams announced the surprise drop on her social media accounts, saying she's 'so moved' by the positive feedback she's received so far for Daughter From Hell."
[Clip of Gracie Abrams' social media post audio plays]
Host: " Abrams also shared a sneak peek of the two new tracks in a couple of playful selfie videos. If you're a fan of her music, you won't want to miss these bonus tracks. Head over to iTunes tonight at 6pm PT to download 'Out of Nowhere' and 'Love Letter' before they're gone."
[Upbeat music fades back in]
Host: "That's all for tonight, folks. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
[Music continues to play until the end of the podcast]
